parsed.rationale: V1–V3 show rS or QS-type complexes with ST elevation, a raised J-point and tall hyperacute-looking T waves, with no ST elevation in the inferior leads. I read the ST elevation by eye only and did not measure it, so the call that it meets STEMI criteria also leans on your note that this was an acute STEMI.
